description: Get UPS shipping rate quotes for an origin/destination zip pair, optionally filtered by service.

weight_lb.description: Package weight in pounds used to scale the charge (default 1.0).

service_code.description: Optional UPS service code to filter rates (e.g. '03').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a UPS RateResponse envelope with rated shipments; on failure (no rates found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a UPS shipment (label) for an origin/destination zip pair and register initial tracking.

service_code.description: UPS service code for the shipment (default '03').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a UPS ShipmentResponse envelope with the tracking number, charges, and label; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get tracking details for a UPS tracking number.

tracking_number.description: The UPS tracking number to look up.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a UPS trackResponse envelope with package status and activity; on failure (tracking number not found), output contains an error message.
